name: Mosswarden · Gremlet #36
description:
An old guardian machine that stood watch so long a meadow grew on its head. It guards the flowers now.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Mosswarden in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
